failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Returned a correction, associated work, yes/no response, or broad category instead of the entity or subtype requested by the clue.

rejected_edits.content: For a prompt consisting only of a person's name, treat it as an elliptical request for an identifying relation only when context makes one relation clearly salient (for example, the country associated with a ruler); answer that relation rather than the person's title. If context does not make the intended relation clear, do not guess.

For a terse work clue consisting of a title with a year or brief label, infer the intended identifying relation from the clue and context rather than defaulting to genre. When context distinctly identifies the work as a retelling, adaptation, or inspiration of another work and that relation fits the clue, give the source or inspiration; otherwise follow the relation the clue supports, including a person or attribution when appropriate.
rejected_edits.target: For a prompt consisting only of a named work and year, infer the intended identifying relation from context; prefer a person or attribution repeatedly and directly associated with the work over a genre label, unless the prompt asks for its genre.
